posts.cooked: Hi, I’m wondering the time zone settings. Can I specify a time zone and let different users know the time for their own.
posts.name: xiasummer
posts.raw: Hi, I'm wondering the time zone settings. Can I specify a time zone and let different users know the time for their own.

posts.cooked:
The time is always displayed in whatever timezone is set in the user’s browser.

Times are stored as unix timestamps (i.e. UTC) and then converted into the user’s timezone in the client via moment.js.

You can see this in action by viewing any events topic, e.g. this topic, in two different timezones.

Screenshot at Sep 20 11-53-31.png963×138 17.4 KB

You can open a chrome window in a different timezone by creating the dir ~/chrome-profile then running

TZ='US/Pacific' open -na "Google Chrome" --args "--user-data-dir=$HOME/chrome-profile"

(See further)
